name: Zaza
overview: Zaza was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Jonathan. Beyond this genealogical note, Scripture does not provide further details about his life or role. His mention is brief and primarily serves to establish lineage within the tribe of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Zaza is a proper name and is understood to be a form of a shortened nickname or term of endearment. It was not given by God and appears in Scripture without additional symbolic meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Zaza is explicitly recorded as the son of Jonathan, linking him directly to this ancestor within the tribe of Judah. No other family relationships are documented in Scripture for Zaza beyond this filial connection.
scriptureSignificance: Zaza's significance lies chiefly in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:33. This genealogical mention contributes to the biblical record of the lineage from which many important biblical figures arose. While Zaza himself is not a prominent character in the narrative, his inclusion underscores the careful preservation of family lines in Scripture.
